# `tfctl profile profiles`

The `tfctl profile profiles` command group manages the set of named tfctl profiles.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles` command group manages the set of named tfctl profiles. You can create new profiles using `tfctl profile profiles create` and activate existing profiles using `tfctl profile profiles activate`. 

To run a single command against a profile other than the active profile, run the command with the `--profile` flag.

A profile is a collection of properties/configuration values that inform the behavior of tfctl CLI. Profiles allow you to conveniently maintain the same settings across command executions, and multiple profiles allow you to easily switch between different projects and settings.

## Subcommands

- [`activate`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/activate) - Activate an existing profile
- [`create`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/create) - Create a new configuration profile
- [`delete`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/delete) - Delete an existing configuration profile
- [`list`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/list) - List existing configuration profiles
- [`rename`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/profiles/rename) - Rename an existing profile

## Examples

The following command creates a new profile:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create my-profile
```

The following command activates an existing profile:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles activate my-profile
```

The following command lists all profiles:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles list
```
